01-rail.html:
- One nginx access log line, followed from collection to deletion.
- Elastic Agent, managed by Fleet, tails access.log and ships to logs-nginx.access-default (type, dataset, namespace).
- The index template's component templates set mappings and settings, including the default ingest pipeline.
- The pipeline parses, enriches and runs your @custom hook.
- Writes land only on the newest backing index; reads span all of them.
- ILM rolls over, ages through warm, cold and frozen, then deletes. SLM snapshots to harborview-backups.
02-iso.html:
- Same flow as an isometric scene: raw multi-colour data turns uniform blue once the pipeline has shaped it.
- Writes hit the active backing index; reads span all of them.
- The rolled-over index steps down through warm, cold and frozen to delete, with an SLM snapshot on the side.
03-metro.html:
- Five stops on one line: collect, template, pipeline, stream, lifecycle.
- The track only enters the newest backing index: that is the write index.
- Rollover makes -000001 read-only; from there it is snapshotted and aged out.
